reason: The claimed normalization is not entailed by any allowed input. def-ha-map and column-hilbert-corner define only the level-one form, while def-hcb-datum merely says the datum contains amplified column spaces and their defined sesquilinear forms; it gives no coordinate formula or normalization relating level n to level one. For example, keeping the prescribed level-one form but taking at n=2 the sesquilinear form <Y,V>_2'=2*sum_i<Y_i,V_i> violates no stated allowed axiom/definition, yet makes sum_i<Y_i,V_i>=<Y,V>_2'/2 rather than <Y,V>_2'. Thus the direct-sum formula with coefficient 1 is a missing definition/dependency, not a derivable definitional bridge, and this node cannot support 1.3.2 as written.
